_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: The Brother, the Friend, the Associate and the Companion
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : أحْبِبْ في اللّهِ مَنْ يُجاهِدُكَ على صَلاحِ دين وَ يُكْسِيكَ(يُكْسِبُكَ) حُسنَ يَقين
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Love for the sake of Allah the one who struggles against you for the betterment of [your] religion and covers you with the mantle of certitude.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: The Brother, the Friend, the Associate and the Companion
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : إرْفَقْ بِإخْوانِكَ وَاكْفِهِمْ غَربَ لِسانِكَ وَ أجْرِ عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْبَ إحسانِكَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Be courteous to your brothers and dont expose them to the harshness of your tongue; and let your goodness flow forth for them.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: The Brother, the Friend, the Associate and the Companion
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : اُبْذُلْ لِصَديقِكَ نُصْحَكَ وَ لِمَعارِفِكَ مَعُونَتَكَ وَ لِكافَّةِ النَّاسِ بِشْرَكَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Offer your advice to your friend, your assistance to your acquaintance, and to all the people, your cheerfulness.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: The Brother, the Friend, the Associate and the Companion
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : إحْذَرْ مُصاحَبَةَ كُلِّ مَنْ يُقْبَلُ رَأيُهُ وَ يُنكَرُ عَمَلُهُ فإنَّ الصّاحِبَ مُعْتَبَرٌ بِصاحِبِهِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Be cautious of the company of one whose opinion is accepted but whose actions are evil, for surely a person is judged by the company he keeps.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: The Brother, the Friend, the Associate and the Companion
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : إحْذَر مُجالِسَةَ قَرينِ السَّوءِ فَإنَّهُ يُهْلِكُ مُقارِنَهُ وَ يُرْدي مُصاحِبَهُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Be careful not to associate with an evil colleague, for his association will destroy you and his companionship will ruin you.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: The Brother, the Friend, the Associate and the Companion
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لا تُؤثِرْ دَنِيّاً عَلى شَريف
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Do not give preference to an ignoble person over a noble one.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: The Brother, the Friend, the Associate and the Companion
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لا تَصْحَبَنَّ مَنْ لا عَقْلَ لَهُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Never associate with one who has no intelligence.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: The Brother, the Friend, the Associate and the Companion
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لا تَصْحَبِ المائِقَ فَيُزَيِّنَ لَكَ فِعْلَهُ وَ يَوَدَّ أنّكَ مِثْلُهُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Do not associate with a fool, for he will embellish his actions for you and want you to become like him.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: The Brother, the Friend, the Associate and the Companion
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لاتَصْحَبَنَّ أبْناءَ الدُّنيا فإنّكَ إنْ أقْلَلْتَ إسْتَثْقَلُوكَ وَ إنْ أكْثَرتَ حَسَدُوكَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Do not associate with those who love this world, for if you have less they will disregard you and if you have more they will envy you.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: The Brother, the Friend, the Associate and the Companion
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لا تُكْثِرَنَّ صُحْبَةَ اللَّئيمِ فإنَّهُ إنْ صَحِبَتْكَ نِعْمَةٌ حَسَدَكَ وَ إنْ طرَقَتْكَ نائِبَةٌ قَذَفَكَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Do not frequent the company of a wicked person, for if you are bestowed with a blessing, he will envy you and if a misfortune befalls you, he will abandon you.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: The Brother, the Friend, the Associate and the Companion
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لا تَسْتَكْثِرَنَّ مِنْ إخوانِ الدُّنيا فَإنَّكَ إنْ عَجَزْتَ عَنْهُمْ تَحَوَّلُوا أعداءً و إنَّ مَثَلَهُمْ كَمَثَلِ النَّارِ كَثيرُها يُحرِقُ وَ قليلُها يَنْفَعُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Do not acquire more ‘worldly brothers, for if you become incapable of fulfilling their wishes they turn into enemies; and their example is like the example of fire – a lot of it burns and a little of it benefits.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: The Brother, the Friend, the Associate and the Companion
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : كُنْ بِالوَحْدَةِ آنَسَ مِنكَ بِقُرَناءِ السُّوءِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Take comfort for yourself in solitude rather than bad company.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: The Brother, the Friend, the Associate and the Companion
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : كُنْ بِعَدُوِّكَ العاقِلِ أوثَقَ مِنْكَ بِصَديقِكَ الجاهِلِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Be more confident of your intelligent foe than your ignorant friend.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: The Brother, the Friend, the Associate and the Companion
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : كُلَّما طالَتِ الصُّحْبَةُ تَأكَّدتِ الحُرْمَةُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Whenever the companionship prolongs, the [mutual] respect is affirmed.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: The Brother, the Friend, the Associate and the Companion
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لِكُلِّ شَيْء آفَةٌ وَ آفَةُ الْخَيْرِ (الخَيِّرِ) قَرينُ السُّوءِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, For everything there is a bane and the bane of a good person is bad company.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: The Brother, the Friend, the Associate and the Companion
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لِكُلِّ شَيْء نَكَدٌ وَ نَكَدُ العُمرِ مُقارَنَةُ العَدُوِّ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, For everything there is a vexation and the vexation of your lifetime is [being in] the company of an enemy.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: The Brother, the Friend, the Associate and the Companion
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لَيْسَ مَنْ خالَطَ الأشرارَ بِذي مَعْقُول
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, One who mingles with the wicked is not intelligent.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي
